The current split is Iref 1uA, tail 1.2uA and stage-2 sink 6.5uA, about 16uW. GBW=gm1/(2*pi*Cc) gives about 1.4MHz with gm1 about 8.5uS and Cc=1pF. For PM, gm7 must exceed about 2.2*2*pi*GBW*CL, about 95uS, so the PMOS CS runs at gm/Id 15. A nulling resistor sets an LHP zero. The NMOS input pair suits VCM=0.9V. Long-L loads and mirrors give A0 above 75dB."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),    # input pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion)
    "L1": (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),          # input pair L
    "Itail": (1.2e-6, 0.6e-6, 2.5e-6),
    "gmidp": (14.0, 8.0, 16.0),     # PMOS mirror load and CS stage (same gm/Id and L for matching)
    "Lp": (0.7, 0.3, 2.0),
    "I7": (6.5e-6, 3e-6, 7.5e-6),   # second-stage current
    "Ln": (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),          # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc": (1.0e-12, 0.4e-12, 3e-12),
    "kRz": (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),         # Rz = kRz / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    Itail, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = Itail / 2.0
    gmidn_cs = 10.0

    # NMOS bias: diode reference, tail source, second-stage sink (same gm/Id and L, so W scales with Id)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmidn_cs, p["Ln"], Iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn_cs, p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.35)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn_cs, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)

    # PMOS mirror load; M7 shares gm/Id and L so its Vsg matches (low systematic offset)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.85)
    m4 = m3
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    Rz = p["kRz"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # first stage: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (overall non-inverting from vinp)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x2", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    # second stage: PMOS common source
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x2", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "x2", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 / (2 * PI * (CL + C1 + CL * C1 / Cc))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7)) if Rz > 1.0 / gm7 else -gm7 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1) if C1 > 0 else 1e12
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir)))
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8)
    power = vdd * (Iref + Itail + I7)
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
```
